name: Dueflo
description: It connects to QuickBooks Online and sends a six-step email and text sequence on overdue invoices. It pauses when the client replies. The price is a flat $49 a month, with no cut of the money collected. Tashkent. One founder. Started January 2026.

mentions.evidence: On Indie Hackers in April 2026 the founder said about $10,000 a month. That post, on 5 April, was still asking for beta testers, so the figure is his claim and it is not checked.
mentions.indieAngle: One accounting pain, one connection, a flat price. The number is the founder's, and the same post was still asking for testers.

whyItPrints: Overdue invoices are the job. The sequence runs until someone answers.
whyThisMatters: An overdue invoice sits there until someone asks. Dueflo connects to QuickBooks Online and runs a six-step email and text sequence, then pauses when the client replies. The price is a flat 49 dollars a month. It does not take a cut of what gets collected. Tashkent. One founder. Started in January 2026. On Indie Hackers in April 2026 he said about 10,000 dollars a month. That post, on 5 April, was still asking for beta testers. So the figure is his claim. It is not checked, and I am not treating a beta-tester post as a settled total. The figure is self-reported, which means the founder said it. I did not open the books. QuickBooks Online is the only connection. The sequence stops when a person writes back. January 2026 is the start.
